orchestrationTrigger null: ADES.md 3.14 says not supported, and the bundled SKILL.md says agents cannot create local workspaces (no CLI or API for them). The Conductor MCP is opt-in and not used here.

Settings: user and project settings are TOML (~/.conductor/settings.toml). setJsonKeys writes JSON top-level keys only, so reset.jsonKeys is empty. Pins that matter (model, effort, claude_code_executable_path, claude_provider) need a TOML seed or a GUI step. ~/.conductor is not in dataDirs, so reset does not move it, and restoreSeed refuses a target that exists.

Agents: the app runs its bundled Claude Code 2.1.300 and Codex 0.162.1 (main.strings). ADES rule 5 wants the system claude 2.1.303. claude_code_executable_path in ~/.conductor/settings.toml is the override; it is not set yet. The bundled binaries sit in ~/Library/Application Support/com.conductor.app/bin, inside dataDirs, so reset removes them and the app downloads them again.

Login: agent-cli. Conductor uses the Claude Code and Codex logins already on the Mac (installation doc and FAQ). It also needs gh auth in the terminal environment. login.files is empty because none of these live in dataDirs. The conductor.db settings table (anthropic_api_key, anthropic_base_url) does live in dataDirs, so reset would drop an API key set in the app.

openProject (checked): opening the plain arena (no remote) asks 'Create a private GitHub repo?' (it would create zqkra/<name> on GitHub and push): never accept that. With a local bare clone as origin (made inside .git so it is new every block and invisible to git status) the project is added, and Conductor creates and opens a workspace branched from origin/main (~/conductor/workspaces/<repo>/<city>). The four git run steps do that, then 'Open project' (711,431), the open panel, cmd+shift+g, the path, Enter, Enter.

It was gpt-5.6-sol; on 2026-10-24 it was set to opus-5-5-1m (the id Conductor 0.91.2 uses for 'Opus 5.5', effort high in local-storage model-picker-configs), and loadout slot 1 was switched to Claude Code / Opus 5.5 / High in Settings > Default models. Replay (checked): with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in launchd the agent (~/Library/Application Support/com.conductor.app/agent-binaries/claude/2.1.300/claude, Conductor's own build) had it in its env and showed 'Retrying (attempt n/10)' with no server on 8787, so Conductor reaches the replay server. The agent binary lives in a dataDir, so a reset removes it and the app re-provisions it.

BLOCKER (checked 2026-10-24): the first launch after ~/Library/Application Support/com.conductor.app is created anew stays a black window (Tauri webview never paints; OCR empty after 60 s, no dialog, app frontmost). Reproduced by hand with an empty folder, with only the window state, with conductor.db or agent-binaries/bin seeded, and even with an identical copy of a folder that had just rendered. Quitting and launching again on the same folder renders Home within 3 s, also with an immediate resize. reset() moves the folder aside every block, so every block's launch is a first launch; a profile cannot quit and relaunch (the harness keeps the first pid). Needs a harness change (a warm-up launch after reset, or not moving this folder).

The thread pane shows only the red text 'Your annual license key to use Virtuoso Message List in non-production environments has expired ... purchase a new key from https://virtuoso.dev/pricing/' (y about 80-115) and the message list stays empty: a workspace whose agent finished (renamed 'Unchanged reply' by the agent) has no user or assistant text on screen, and the Accessibility tree of the list group is empty. Crash on quit (2026-11-09, ADEMARK-43): all 12 crash reports of 5 to 8 Nov (conductor-*.ips of the ademark account, read for notes/orca-conductor-cloudroom-causes-from-the-evidence-of-8-and-9.md) are one Conductor 0.91.2 bug. Thread sqlx-sqlite-worker-1, EXC_BAD_ACCESS SIGBUS KERN_MEMORY_ERROR, frames walIndexTryHdr, walIndexReadHdr, sqlite3WalCheckpoint, sqlite3WalClose, sqlite3PagerClose: SQLite crashes while it closes its database and reads the WAL shared memory. Each crash is the quit of the reset() warm-up launch, about 15 s after the open (example conductor-2026-11-05-053535.ips: launch 05:35:11.29, capture 05:35:26.58 -0500). It does not stop a run: gate-conductor-2026-11-07T08-34-37Z-1 crashed the same way and wrote 37 rows. The harness leaves Conductor's database files alone.
